+def test_unpickle_with_device_pixel_ratio():
+    """Test that unpickling a figure doesn't double the DPI."""
+    import pickle
+    from io import BytesIO
+    
+    fig = plt.figure()
+    original_dpi = fig.dpi
+    
+    # Unpickle multiple times
+    for i in range(3):
+        buf = BytesIO()
+        pickle.dump(fig, buf, pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)
+        buf.seek(0)
+        fig = pickle.load(buf)
+        # DPI should remain the same after unpickling
+        assert fig.dpi == original_dpi, \
+            f"After unpickle {i+1}: expected DPI {original_dpi}, got {fig.dpi}"
